versions.changelog: Synchronize Shopify Skill Hub onboarding and runtime configuration improvements.
Release 2.1.1: clarify product image Alt Text checks and optional vision fallback boundaries.
Release 2.0.0: unified SemVer and safer onboarding metadata.

- Initial release of Shopify Product SERP Optimizer.
- Audits and improves Shopify product SERP performance in five-product batches.
- Provides evidence-backed metadata recommendations and generates HTML audit reports.
- Supports safe writes for approved product metadata; all changes subject to user approval.
- Operates in multiple modes (admin custom app, dev dashboard app, public storefront) with separate rules for each.
- Focused exclusively on product-page SERP optimization—not technical SEO, themes, redirects, or translations.
